transcript.text: Hi everyone, I wanted to get us together for our preflight meeting before I lock the livestream production package for the fan Q&A. We've got the 7:00 to 8:00 PM slot on the festival platform, with the featured guest segment from 7:00 to 7:30 and then audience questions after, plus a sponsor message near the end. Before I finalize anything, I need each of you — technical, talent, and sponsorship leads — to report any confirmed constraints or changes so I can record them and lock the package. What are we working with?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a confirmed technical constraint. During today's platform latency test, I confirmed that audience questions must run through a moderated queue with a 30-second delay. Direct audience-to-guest questions would not be safely controllable on this platform. I haven't entered this in the production brief yet, but it needs to be factored into the package before we lock it.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a confirmed talent constraint to report. I spoke with the featured guest's agent this morning, and the guest is only available from 7:15 PM through 7:45 PM, inclusive, due to a separate appearance. I haven't updated the shared run-of-show yet, but this directly conflicts with the current draft that has the guest segment starting at 7:00 PM.
